appDetails.name: Pixel Stretch
appDetails.shortDescription: Pixel stretch effects + AI background removal. 11 tools, layers, offline.
appDetails.description:
Transform your photos with creative pixel stretch effects. Features 11 unique tools including Radial Stretch, Mirror, Twirl, Warp Grid, and AI-powered background removal. Full layer support, blend modes, and filters — all processing happens on-device. Your photos never leave your device.

Features:
• 11 stretch & warp tools
• AI background removal (on-device)
• Multi-layer editing
• Blend modes & filters
• PNG/JPEG/WebP export
• Save & resume projects
• Offline — no account required
• Dark & light themes
• IT/EN localization
